title: Versammlungsgeschehen zu einem angezeigten Aufzug anlässlich des 10. Muharram

extraction.summaryEn: A registered assembly ("Aschura-Marsch") with about 600 participants marched from the Berliner Dom to Gendarmenmarkt. A staged depiction of children bound together was banned by police, and several participants needed medical treatment for heat-related circulatory problems; the assembly was otherwise peaceful.
